_comment: Phase 10 (plan): reference tolerance band for scripts/verify_repro.py, seeded from a real, verified completed smoke run -- results/fl/e35285b33a_0.json (gitignored, kept locally; git_sha 9b01a4621a256e2c170501fc7608197411165590, this repo's own phase-4 commit; provenance.gpu.available=false, CPU runtime -- see docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md's Phase 3 breakthrough entry). Not a statistically-estimated band from many runs (only one real completed run exists so far) -- a generous absolute tolerance around that single verified data point, wide enough to absorb float-determinism drift across platforms/torch versions, tight enough to catch a genuinely broken pipeline (e.g. a model that never trains at all, or a crash reported as success).
